subject: AlphaHealth — SSO/SCIM evidence & role justification
messages:
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@alphahealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: AlphaHealth Security <security@alphahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: SSO assertions + role mapping for SOC2 review

Hi Sean —

AlphaHealth is preparing for a SOC 2 re-audit and our assessor has asked for a small bundle of artifacts from Redwood related to our SSO integration. Can you please provide the following for the last 30 days?

- SAML assertion samples (ID/Issuer/Subject/NameID, timestamps) — 10-15 records across successful federations and a couple of failed attempts.
- SCIM delta logs (provisioning events) for the last 30 days (create/update/deactivate), ideally in JSON or CSV.
- Current role mapping snapshot (Redwood role -> AlphaHealth role), and a brief justification for any roles that carry admin privileges (why least privilege is preserved).
- Any RBAC policy documents or short explanation of separation of duties for admin scopes.

We understand some fields might contain PII. We can accept redacted assertions as long as the timestamps, issuers, and assertion IDs are preserved. Please let us know an ETA and whether you need a formal NDA addendum for logs.

Thanks,
Lisa Tran
InfoSec Manager, AlphaHealth
security@alphahealth.com

(Attaching: AlphaHealth-SOC2-checklist.pdf)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@alphahealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SSO assertions + role mapping for SOC2 review

Lisa — thanks for the clear list. We'll gather these artifacts. Quick notes and a proposed plan: 

- We can export SAML assertion samples from our Okta integration logs (we'll redact user-identifiable attributes unless you require them unredacted).
- SCIM deltas are available from our provisioning service; we can deliver raw JSON or a CSV summary.
- Role snapshot and admin-privilege justification: Grace will own the write-up.

ETA: initial bundle within 3 business days (by Wed 2027-06-02), full extracts and justification by EOD Fri 2027-06-04 if you need more context.

Question: Do you prefer hashed identifiers (SHA256) in place of NameIDs, or full NameID values with redaction? Also: is there an internal intake/tracking number we should put on each artifact?

I created SEC-874 for our internal tracking (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-874).

I'll coordinate and upload artifacts to a restricted Drive folder with view-only links.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@alphahealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SSO assertions + role mapping for SOC2 review

Thanks Sean — here's the plan and exact deliverables I'll produce: 

1) SAML assertion samples
   - Export 12 assertions spanning success/failure from Okta system logs (fields: AssertionID, Issuer, Subject/NameID, IssueInstant, NotOnOrAfter, Status).
   - Produce two variants: (a) redacted PII (NameID hashed) and (b) minimally redacted (NameID preserved but email local-part masked).
   - File: okta_saml_assertions_202705.csv (CSV with column headers).

2) SCIM delta exports
   - Pull provisioning events for AlphaHealth tenant (2027-04-30 -> 2027-05-30).
   - Include event type, timestamp, actor_id, target_user_id (hashed), attribute changes.
   - File: scim_deltas_202704-202705.json (JSON array) and a parsed scim_deltas_202705_summary.csv.

3) Role snapshot + role justification
   - Current RBAC mapping CSV: role_snapshot_202705.csv (columns: redwood_role, alpha_role, privileges, assigned_principals_count).
   - A short paragraph (inlined) justifying admin roles and controls (approval workflows, JIT, MFA, audit logging).

4) Access matrix explainer (PDF) — short one-pager summarizing enforcement points and SSO/SCIM flow.

Logistics / redaction: we will default to hashed identifiers except where timestamps and issuer fields must remain human-readable for auditors. If AlphaHealth needs original unredacted values for a narrow sampling, we'll require a brief attestation form.

I'll collect the artifacts and upload to a Drive folder with restricted access; Sean will share the link to AlphaHealth. 

ETA: I can have the first attachments uploaded by Tue 2027-06-01 EOD Pacific. If AlphaHealth confirms they need exact NameIDs unredacted for sampling, we can do that under a short attestation (please confirm).

Grace O'Connor
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

(Attachments planned: okta_saml_assertions_202705.csv, scim_deltas_202704-202705.json, role_snapshot_202705.csv, access_matrix_explainer.pdf)

From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@alphahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SSO assertions + role mapping for SOC2 review

Grace / Sean —

Thanks for the plan. AlphaHealth is fine with hashed identifiers for the bulk of records. For the SAML assertion samples, we do need the NameID for at least 2 successful and 1 failed assertion unredacted (the assessor needs issuer + NameID for correlation); all other NameIDs may be hashed.

We do not need a formal NDA addendum; a short attestation email confirming the artifacts are genuine and generated from production logs is sufficient. Can you include that with the artifact upload?

DocuSign is not required unless you need to restrict delivery further.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Lisa

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@alphahealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SSO assertions + role mapping for SOC2 review

Lisa — attaching the bundle and a short attestation as requested. 

Deliverables (uploaded to restricted Drive):
- okta_saml_assertions_202705.csv (12 samples; 3 NameIDs left unredacted for assessor correlation)
- scim_deltas_202704-202705.json (raw delta events)
- role_snapshot_202705.csv (current role mapping)
- access_matrix_explainer.pdf (one-pager)

Drive link (view-only, AlphaHealth invited): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Ald3-example-drive-link

Attestation (short): "I confirm these artifacts are exported directly from Redwood Inference production logs for the AlphaHealth tenant and have not been modified aside from approved redaction. — Sean Gallagher, Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference"

Notes / next steps: 
- Priyom / Jonas: please follow up with the assessor if they request inline logs or additional correlation keys.
- Lisa: let us know if you want a narrow sample of unredacted SCIM events; we'll require an attestation confirmation before release.
